originalHarnessReview.originalFullWindowsAndFirstPair: Original begin/checkpoint calls, selectors, fixture, authentication and same five-pair sequence remain; diagnostic does not select a different FIRST pair or alter thresholds.
originalHarnessReview.installation: Web attaches before ordinary goto, within the original Web full-login window. Native attaches only once after app.firstWindow; it is explicitly late. Later cold/hosted launches do not install the diagnostic hook.
originalHarnessReview.postWindowSnapshots: Both readDiagnostics.snapshot calls occur strictly after the original complete workspace-selection-to-usable checkpoint. They read only diagnostic state and introduce no pg/HTTP application read.
originalHarnessReview.finalization: Sidecar write occurs after original release/cleanup/RPC diagnostic collection. Failure is caught into evidence.readDiagnostics unavailable; original passed/cleanup outcome and lifecycle.json write/audit remain.
originalHarnessReview.timingBoundary: Diagnostic awaits/CPU/IPC perturb scheduling. Initial Native attachment also precedes the original navigation observer installation; old observer-relative elapsed values must not be treated as an unchanged absolute clock. This is a declared diagnostic cost, not moved SQL checkpoint semantics.

collectorReview.documentIdentity: Generated UUID belongs to actual top-level document installation, paired with performance.timeOrigin, initializedWallMs/MonotonicMs and per-product wall/monotonic times. Same-document events do not fabricate new UUIDs. Native initial prehook gap is preserved via attachmentLate and incomplete.
collectorReview.cdp: Network payload stores only closed path families, method/status, local request/loader IDs and clock values. No request body, headers, raw URL, URL query or user/workspace/server-invocation ID is copied. CDP frameNavigated is a navigation event with local loader ID, never a document UUID.
collectorReview.causality: Product RPC action times and CDP request/path times are separate observations. No exact cross-layer action/request/document join is fabricated from timing. Ambiguous associations stay unknown.
collectorReview.delivery: Synchronous sink exceptions and async rejection affect diagnostic failure counts only. Binding delivery is not awaited by product functions. Node append retains at most2048 rows/512KiB of serialized row bytes and counts discarded rows/bytes.
collectorReview.completeness: Unknown schemas, omitted references/intern IDs/actions, lost/duplicate sequences, missing/unsealed/late documents, pending delivery and sink failures keep the report incomplete. Advancing product sequence invalidates an earlier seal; only later seal/snapshot can reseal.
collectorReview.initialLateRace: Both writer and validator include page.attachmentLate. A new late:false document racing manual Native installation cannot hide the initial prehook gap.
collectorReview.tail: Collector covers attachment through ordinary context close, including setup/post-window tail. Original two login window timestamps are copied unchanged; row analysis must use those boundaries rather than the total collector span.
collectorReview.countSemantics: Failure/pending counters sum observations and can repeat at snapshot/seal; they are conservative completeness signals, not unique-failure totals.
collectorReview.io: A0600 sidecar is written outside original login windows, then the existing evidence audit runs. Importing collector does not execute audit CLI; CLI is guarded by exact module path.

resolvedMustFix.finding: Incorrect action allowlist labels obscured switchWorkspace/modelMenu.
Double-escaped ISO regex rejected real window timestamps.
Snapshot-sealed document stayed sealed when later product sequences arrived.
Native early-document gap could be hidden when navigation beat manual late installation.
Cost wording implied totalCPU/IPC bounded by retained row buffer.

blindSpots: This is not zero-overhead instrumentation. Every observation performs scalar work; binding/CDP add CPU/IPC. Retained storage is bounded but total event delivery and browser pending IPC are not capped by the row limit.
Native initial document before hook is incomplete by design. It cannot become complete through a fresh later document.
Only two full-login pages are instrumented; cold FIRST source still contains no-op observer calls but has no installed sink/capture.
read_fresh not_returned identifies a decision branch, not the precise cache-object/comparator/revision mutation cause. No extra cache or applied read was added to find that cause.
Opaque module/document-local IDs preserve privacy. No raw key/owner/workspace/args/server invocation IDs are available; some causality remains ambiguous.
Sidecar rows may include setup and post-window tail. They are never substitutes for the original full SQL budget windows.
A diagnostic green count is not formal budget PASS or proof of a permanent fix; product root cause remains unknown until the observation is analyzed.
